newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Diplomat to be named new Colombia defense chief.
newsitem.headline: Diplomat to be named new Colombia defense chief.

text.p: Colombia's ambassador to Venezuela, Guillermo Alberto Gonzalez, is to be named defense minister, government sources said on Wednesday.
The appointment was scheduled to be announced next Monday, the sources said.

Gonzalez, who took up his post in Caracas nine months ago, will replace outgoing defense chief Juan Carlos Esguerra, who will take up the vacant post of Colombian ambassador to the United States on Jan. 20.
Gonzalez was formerly labor minister and a government negotiator in failed peace talks with rebel movements in 1984.
